s.note: camp dinner before the Thanksgiving play
s.how: Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 1 diced green capsicum for 10 minutes. Add 200ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp American mustard and 100ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Split 12 slider buns, lay half a slice of cheddar on each base, spoon on the mince and top with sliced dill pickles.

Beat 250g butter with 100g icing sugar and mix in 350g flour. Roll out, cut rounds and bake at 160C for 15 minutes. Cool, then pipe a thin line of 50g melted dark chocolate across each as a small smile.

m.how: Split 4 lobster tails and brush with 80g butter melted with 2 garlic cloves and lemon zest. Grill flesh side up for 6 to 8 minutes. Boil 800g new potatoes and toss with butter. Serve with dressed salad leaves and lemon wedges.

w.how: Roast 800g pumpkin, purée and whisk with 3 eggs, 150g brown sugar, 200ml cream and 2 tsp mixed spice. Pour into a blind-baked case of 2 sheets sweet shortcrust and bake at 170C for 50 minutes. Cool before slicing.

d.note: the camp canteen at Camp Chippewa
d.how: Blend 200g frozen raspberries with 150ml fresh lemon juice (about 5 lemons) and 150ml sugar syrup until smooth, then strain out the seeds. Return to the blender with 500ml cold water and 4 cups of ice and blend until thick and slushy. Pour into 4 tall cups with a lemon wheel and a spoon straw.
